npm-3-1.summary: Release-age routines retain native array some, map/filter, flatMap and filter operations missed by the green gates.
npm-3-1.fix: Use A.some, A.filterMap with an Option result and the existing numeric/finite guard, A.flatMap and A.filter. Preserve the maximum/non-negative clamp, sorted deduplicated excludes, wildcard scan, DateFromString parsing, output order and inert-gate original-array return. Preserve existing oracle assertions; no test-file edit is required.

npm-3-2.summary: Manifest.needsResolution retains two native Array.some calls despite equivalent Effect helpers.
npm-3-2.fix: Import effect/Array as A and use A.some for DependencyField.literals and R.values(section). Preserve absent-section behavior, short-circuit evaluation and catalog/workspace predicates, and retain own-key-preserving manifest resolution. No test-file edit is required.

npm-3-3.summary: Default cache-directory construction uses native Array.join despite an equivalent Effect helper.
npm-3-3.fix: Import effect/Array as A and replace the under helper's native join with A.join([home, ...parts], windows ? "\\" : "/"). Preserve every path byte, platform separator and trailing-home-separator behavior. No test-file edit is required.

npm-3-4.summary: Seeded registry dictionary indexing reads inherited keys and reports unseeded constructor/toString versions as published.
npm-3-4.fix: Use R.get and Option composition for own-key registry/package/version lookup and the other seeded methods, including optional distTags package lookup. Preserve absent defaults, own seeded keys, integrity/timestamp handling and order. Add NpmRegistry.test.ts regressions for inherited version, registry/package and dist-tag keys, plus a successful explicitly seeded own constructor version. Preserve oracle tests; supply upstream-bug deviation evidence to the central codemod without editing ledger or Port notes.

npm-3-5.summary: Pack fixtures and PackageManagerPin rejection names use native JSON.stringify outside the Effect contexts enforced by tsgo.
npm-3-5.fix: Replace PackagePublish.test.ts:42,49,447 serialization with S.fromJsonString(S.Unknown) encoding through explicit Result codecs for synchronous setup or Effect codecs for effectful setup. Preserve npm 11 array, npm 12 keyed-object and malformed missing-filename fixtures. Replace PackageManagerPin.test.ts:111 rejection-name quoting with a Schema string JSON codec. Preserve bytes, test names and oracle assertions; make any Result unwrapping failure explicit at the test boundary without synchronous Schema codecs. Documentation changes remain backlog.
